introduction.title: Sergio Asensio Puyuelo
content: I am Sergio Asensio, a Technical Lead with over 9 years of experience in technological solutions. I graduated in Mathematics from the University of Zaragoza, and since then, I have worked in the development of web, mobile, and IoT solutions.
Throughout my career, I have led complex projects and worked with multidisciplinary teams, creating scalable and efficient solutions that optimize processes and make an impact in various sectors.

technologies.title: Architecture and Technologies
content: I have experience in designing and developing architectures for applications in front-end (Angular, React) and back-end (Node, Java, Python), and in creating mobile applications with Flutter. I have also worked with ThingsBoard to develop IoT solutions, enabling integration, visualization, and real-time data analysis.

One of my specialties is containerizing applications, enhancing portability, scalability, and optimizing deployments on platforms such as Azure, OpenShift, and Heroku. I have led the configuration of Continuous Integration pipelines with tools like GitLab CI, ensuring efficiency and quality in development and deployment processes.

Throughout my career, I have also created reusable code templates that facilitate the development of scalable and sustainable projects. Additionally, I developed internal video tutorials to train the team technologically, boosting their learning and growth.

agile.title: Agility and Team Management
content: In my projects, I promote the use of agile methodologies such as SCRUM and Kanban, optimizing workflows and ensuring fast and quality deliveries. We develop clear Roadmaps, aligning the team's objectives with business needs. To ensure code quality, I adopt Gitflow as a version control strategy, and I supervise the team's work through Pull Requests (PRs), ensuring the code meets standards before being integrated into the main repository.

I strongly believe in the human value within a team. Fostering an environment of trust, collaboration, and continuous learning is key to the success of any project. I promote knowledge transfer, which not only improves technical skills but also strengthens the team's autonomy and motivation. For me, the well-being of the team is essential, and I ensure a balance between productivity and a healthy work environment that fosters creativity and innovation.

about_me.title: About me...
content: I am persistent with the goals I pursue, and this is one of the aspects I enjoy most about my work. I see each day as a challenge, and the more challenging and new it is, the greater my motivation. Continuous learning and innovation are essential for growth, and I always seek to apply new technologies and approaches to optimize my projects.

I deeply value the foundations and structure of a project. The foundations are key to building modules efficiently, and the structure is essential to avoid chaos: without a competent, well-organized team with defined roles, problems arise quickly.
